text.p: Temporary employment agency Randstad NV said on Tuesday it planned a 2.5-for-one share split.
Randstad said it aimed at a wide spread of shareholders, in order to increase familiarity with the company and to stabilise price movements in its shares.
It said the split should enable Randstad shares to remain attractive to smaller investors, and increase liquidity in the stock.

Randstad said the split, which is to be approved in the general shareholders meeting held on May 16, will result in a nominal value of 20 cents (NLG 0.20) per share, down from a previous fifty cents. The split shares will be listed as such on the Amsterdam stock exchange in the autumn of this year.
